counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext -layout extraction with heading- and paragraph-bounded functional segments. Running headers, standalone page numbers, displayed equations, table bodies, and figure captions are excluded where identifiable. Mechanical counts remain drafts until reconciled against all 21 rendered pages; final schema-v3 layouts preserve visually reviewed paragraph functions and evidence-bearing overlaps.
ambiguities: I.2 and Figure 2 begin at the foot of PDF page 2, so problem-analysis must touch pages 2-3 rather than only page 3.
II.1 begins at the foot of page 4, which is shared by assumptions and model-establishment; heading bounds assign each prose block to its function.
II.3 begins at the foot of page 10 with the fixed-width simulation protocol, before its first result figure appears on page 11.
Model-establishment, results, robustness-verification, and strengths-limitations overlap because equations, checks, plots, and interpretations are interleaved.
Display equations and table rows are poorly represented in extracted text; formula counts and visual evidence are therefore reconciled from rendered pages, not inferred from mechanical prose counts.
